summary: Join our Empowering Women in Education and Employment Training Course. Enhance your skills, boost your career, and connect with a supportive community.
lede: Women’s empowerment in education and employment training examines barriers to women’s access, advancement, and influence in learning and work. It is for educators, HR and talent leaders, policymakers, and development professionals who need to turn gender-equality goals into institutional action. Participants learn to assess barriers, apply gender-responsive planning, and design leadership pathways and measures for tracking progress.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals working in gender equality, education, and workforce development, including:
modules: Barriers and Enablers in Women’s Education
Addressing Bias and Creating Inclusive Cultures
